title.zh: 路由故障使Solana险些丧失最终确定性
title.en: Routing Bug Puts Solana Within 4.5 Points of Losing Finality

summary.zh: 周三上午，托管服务商Teraswitch一条配置错误的BGP路由导致28.83%的质押SOL离线，使Solana距离停止交易最终确认的33.34%阈值仅差4.51个百分点。约90个验证者受到影响，网络在约33分钟后恢复。 这一事件是对Solana网络稳定性的严峻压力测试：单一服务商的配置错误险些让整条链停止工作，暴露出质押SOL在个别自治系统中的高度集中。它凸显了验证者、质押协议和整个生态面临的风险，并可能促使人们更加强烈地呼吁改善去中心化和故障切换实践。 受影响的自治系统AS20326持有约27%的质押SOL，超过Solana基金会委托计划25%的上限，其中94%在同一时间离线。Marinade Finance发现，59个验证者持有的8020万SOL在路由重新收敛后恢复，而Helius则整整离线33分钟；损失的333 SOL奖励将由验证者保证金弥补。
summary.en: A misconfigured BGP route at hosting provider Teraswitch took 28.83% of staked SOL offline on Wednesday morning, leaving Solana just 4.51 percentage points short of the 33.34% threshold at which the chain stops finalizing transactions. Roughly 90 validators were affected, and networking recovered after about 33 minutes. This incident is a severe stress test for Solana's network stability: a single provider misconfiguration nearly halted the entire chain, exposing how concentrated staked SOL is within one autonomous system. It underscores risks for validators, staking protocols, and the broader ecosystem, and could intensify calls for better decentralization and failover practices. The affected autonomous system, AS20326, holds roughly 27% of staked SOL — above the 25% cap in the Solana Foundation's delegation program — and 94% of it went offline at once. Marinade Finance found that 80.2 million SOL across 59 validators recovered after routing reconverged, while Helius was down for the full 33 minutes; the 333 SOL in lost rewards will be covered by validator bonds.

title.zh: Bybit就15亿美元加密货币失窃起诉朝鲜
title.en: Bybit sues North Korea over $1.5B crypto theft

summary.zh: Bybit已就交易所15亿美元加密货币被盗事件对朝鲜提起诉讼。这一法律行动将纠纷升级为针对国家行为体的正式诉讼。 该诉讼可能为加密货币交易所如何向国家支持的黑客追讨资金开创法律先例。它也凸显了国家安全、国际法与数字资产行业之间日益紧密的交集。 此次盗窃发生在Bybit平台上，是有史以来最大规模的加密货币盗窃事件之一。该诉讼的具体法律依据和管辖权尚未公开披露。
summary.en: Bybit has filed a lawsuit against North Korea in connection with the $1.5 billion theft of cryptocurrency from the exchange. This legal action escalates the dispute to a formal court case against a state actor. The lawsuit could set a legal precedent for how cryptocurrency exchanges pursue recovery from state-sponsored hackers. It also highlights the growing intersection of national security, international law, and the digital asset industry. The theft occurred on Bybit's platform and is among the largest cryptocurrency heists ever recorded. The specific legal grounds and jurisdiction for the lawsuit have not yet been publicly disclosed.

title.zh: Solana 接近最终性中断，28.83% 质押 SOL 脱机
title.en: Solana Nears Finality Halt as 28.83% of Staked SOL Goes Delinquent

summary.zh: 2026年8月12日，基础设施提供商 Teraswitch 的路由故障导致 28.83% 的已质押 SOL 脱机，使 Solana 走到了最终性中断门槛的 86% 处。Marinade 报告称，其自治系统上的 1.1889 亿枚 SOL 中有 94% 离线。 该事件凸显了 Solana 验证者基础设施中的系统性集中风险：单一提供商的路由问题险些威胁到全网最终性。它还直接影响了 Solana 最大的流动性质押协议 Marinade，并可能动摇整个生态对质押可靠性的信心。 Teraswitch 确认，故障由例常配置变更触发的路由软件错误引起，共影响 12 个站点。Solana 仅在超过 33.34% 的已质押 SOL 脱机时才会停止最终性；本次约有 90 个验证者受影响并损失了质押奖励。
summary.en: On August 12, 2026, a routing failure at infrastructure provider Teraswitch caused 28.83% of staked SOL to go delinquent, bringing Solana 86% of the way to the threshold at which block finality halts. Marinade reported that 94% of the 118.89 million SOL on its autonomous system went offline. The event highlights systemic concentration risk in Solana's validator infrastructure, because a single provider's routing problem nearly threatened network-wide finality. It also directly affected Marinade, Solana's largest liquid staking protocol, and could shake confidence in staking reliability across the ecosystem. Teraswitch confirmed the outage was caused by a routing software failure triggered during a routine configuration change, affecting 12 sites. Solana's finality stops only when more than 33.34% of staked SOL is delinquent, and roughly 90 validators were affected, losing staking rewards.

title.zh: Coldcard遭黑客攻击后，150亿美元比特币转向安全自托管
title.en: Coldcard Hack Spurs $15B Bitcoin Migration to Self-Custody

summary.zh: 7月30日开始的Coldcard固件漏洞攻击盗走了约2,100枚BTC（约合1.3亿美元），链上数据显示随后几天有23.3万枚BTC（约合150亿美元）离开长期持有者钱包。Casa首席执行官Nick Neuman表示，其中一部分来自Ledger和Trezor用户升级为多签自托管。 该事件表明，硬件钱包漏洞可以通过分布式自托管来化解，并可能加速长期比特币持有者采用多签方案。它还显示出自我托管在压力下的适应能力，强化了比特币作为资产的韧性。 Checkonchain数据显示，23.3万枚BTC离开了长期持有者钱包，较近期高点下降了1.38%；另有2.2万枚BTC流向交易所。Galaxy Research单独统计到三轮攻击波次中，超过5,200个地址被盗约1,596枚BTC，而固件漏洞将密钥熵从128位降到了约40位。
summary.en: A Coldcard firmware exploit that began July 30 drained roughly 2,100 BTC (~$130 million), and onchain data shows 233,000 BTC (~$15 billion) moved out of long-term holder wallets in the following days. Casa CEO Nick Neuman attributes part of that migration to Ledger and Trezor users upgrading to multisig self-custody. The incident underscores that hardware wallet vulnerabilities can be contained by distributed self-custody, and may accelerate multisig adoption among long-term Bitcoin holders. It also shows self-custody adapting under stress, reinforcing Bitcoin's resilience as an asset. Checkonchain data shows 233,000 BTC left long-term holder wallets—a 1.38% drop from recent highs—while 22,000 BTC moved to exchanges. Galaxy Research separately counted roughly 1,596 BTC stolen across more than 5,200 addresses in three attack waves, and the firmware bug had reduced key entropy from 128 bits to about 40 bits.

title.zh: 路由故障导致约29%质押SOL离线，Solana险些冻结
title.en: Solana Nearly Freezes After Routing Glitch Offlines 29% of Staked SOL

summary.zh: 据质押平台Marinade Finance称，周三上午，源自Teraswitch迈阿密数据中心的路由故障导致Solana近29%的质押代币离线。中断持续约33分钟，使网络距离停止最终确认所需的“三分之一质押代币离线”门槛仅差约2000万枚代币。 这一事件暴露了Solana质押基础设施中的严重中心化风险：单一网络运营商AS2032控制了超过四分之一的质押SOL。一旦离线质押比例超过三分之一，整个链将停止出块，所有SOL持有者都会受影响，这进一步引发了对Solana作为领先智能合约平台可靠性的质疑。 大约90个验证者受到影响，共损失约333枚SOL的奖励，数额相对较小，由“验证者债券”覆盖。故障路由从Teraswitch扩散到欧洲和亚洲的数据中心，导致伦敦、阿姆斯特丹、法兰克福、新加坡和东京的验证者断线；北美保持在线，流量在UTC时间4:16前恢复。
summary.en: On Wednesday, a routing glitch traced to Teraswitch's Miami data center knocked nearly 29% of Solana's staked tokens offline, according to staking platform Marinade Finance. The outage lasted about 33 minutes and brought the network to within about 20 million tokens of the one-third staked threshold that halts finality. The incident exposes a serious centralization risk in Solana's staking infrastructure: a single network operator, AS2032, controlled more than a quarter of all staked SOL. Had the offline stake exceeded one-third, the entire chain would have frozen for every SOL holder, raising broader questions about Solana's reliability as a leading smart contract platform. Roughly 90 validators were affected and lost about 333 SOL in rewards, a relatively small sum covered by validator bonds. The bad route from Teraswitch spread to European and Asian data centers, cutting off validators in London, Amsterdam, Frankfurt, Singapore and Tokyo; North America stayed online, and traffic was restored by 4:16 a.m. UTC.

title.zh: 高盛拟斥资至多22.5亿美元收购Neos，纳入比特币和以太坊收益ETF
title.en: Goldman Sachs to Buy Neos for $2.25B, Adding Bitcoin and Ether ETFs

summary.zh: 高盛宣布将以至多22.5亿美元收购Neos Investments。该交易将使高盛获得Neos旗下比特币高收益ETF、增强型比特币高收益ETF和以太坊高收益ETF。 一家顶级全球投行专门通过收购来获得加密货币收益型ETF，标志着数字资产领域更深层次的机构采纳。此举可能加速比特币和以太坊受监管产品的主流分销。 该收购交易价值至多22.5亿美元。Neos的比特币高收益ETF（BTCI）于2024年10月16日推出，增强型比特币高收益ETF（XBCI）于2026年1月22日推出，以太坊高收益ETF（NEHI）则通过期权和投资于现货以太坊ETP来产生月度收益。
summary.en: Goldman Sachs announced it will acquire Neos Investments for up to $2.25 billion. The deal gives Goldman access to Neos's Bitcoin High Income ETF, Boosted Bitcoin High Income ETF, and Ethereum High Income ETF. A top-tier global investment bank is making a dedicated acquisition to own cryptocurrency income-generating ETFs, signaling deeper institutional adoption of digital assets. The move could accelerate mainstream distribution of regulated bitcoin and ether products. The acquisition is valued at up to $2.25 billion. Neos's Bitcoin High Income ETF (BTCI) launched on October 16, 2024, the Boosted Bitcoin High Income ETF (XBCI) launched on January 22, 2026, and the Ethereum High Income ETF (NEHI) uses options and investments in spot Ether ETPs to generate monthly income.

title.zh: SEC无异议函允许富兰克林坦伯顿基金使用链上BENJI系统
title.en: SEC No-Action Letter Lets Franklin Templeton Funds Use Onchain BENJI

summary.zh: 美国SEC发布了一封无异议函，允许富兰克林坦伯顿的传统注册基金投资其链上BENJI/FOBXX代币化货币市场基金。这是监管层面的首次，直接允许传统基金载体持有代币化基金。 这标志着代币化金融产品的重大监管里程碑，显示出SEC对链上基金基础设施的清晰度和接受度不断提升。这可能加速机构对代币化货币市场基金的采用，并鼓励其他传统资产管理公司整合基于区块链的系统。 FOBXX（富兰克林链上美国政府货币基金）主要投资于美国政府证券，并依赖BENJI区块链系统进行记录保存和所有权追踪。该无异议函明确允许富兰克林的传统注册基金购买该代币化基金的份额，但须遵守函中列出的条件。
summary.en: The U.S. SEC issued a no-action letter allowing Franklin Templeton's traditional registered funds to invest in its onchain BENJI/FOBXX tokenized money market fund. This is a regulatory first that directly permits conventional fund vehicles to hold a tokenized fund. This marks a significant regulatory milestone for tokenized financial products, signaling growing SEC clarity and acceptance of onchain fund infrastructure. It could accelerate institutional adoption of tokenized money market funds and encourage other traditional asset managers to integrate blockchain-based systems. FOBXX (Franklin OnChain U.S. Government Money Fund) invests primarily in U.S. government securities and relies on the BENJI blockchain system for record-keeping and ownership tracking. The no-action letter specifically permits Franklin's traditional registered funds to purchase shares of the tokenized fund, subject to the conditions outlined in the letter.

title.zh: 美SEC推进代币化证券豁免 支持7x24小时交易
title.en: SEC Advances Tokenized-Securities Exemption for 24/7 Trading

summary.zh: 美国证券交易委员会（SEC）正在推进一项针对代币化证券的豁免框架，旨在允许合规的链上交易，并可能实现7x24小时市场，同时长期规则仍在制定中。SEC高级官员阿特金斯（Atkins）表示，该框架将支持此类交易，而周五的委员会会议讨论的是另一项独立的发行提案。 此举可能显著降低代币化证券的监管不确定性，并为传统资产在区块链网络上实现全天候交易铺平道路。这标志着美国监管机构在现行证券法框架内接纳链上金融的重要一步，可能影响传统及加密市场中的发行人、交易所和投资者。 该豁免框架仍处于初步阶段，尚未最终确定；长期规则仍在制定中。SEC定于周五的委员会会议讨论的是另一项独立的发行提案，而非这一豁免框架。
summary.en: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) is advancing an exemption framework for tokenized securities that would allow compliant onchain trading, potentially enabling 24/7 markets while long-term rules are developed. A senior SEC official, Atkins, said the framework would support such trading, and Friday's scheduled Commission consideration covers a separate offering proposal. This move could meaningfully reduce regulatory uncertainty for tokenized securities and pave the way for round-the-clock trading of traditional assets on blockchain networks. It marks a notable step by U.S. regulators to accommodate onchain finance within existing securities law, potentially affecting issuers, exchanges, and investors in both traditional and crypto markets. The exemption framework is still a preliminary step and has not been finalized; long-term rules are still being developed. The SEC's scheduled Friday Commission consideration addresses a separate offering proposal, not this exemption framework.

title.zh: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 登陆 OpenRouter，以极低成本对标顶尖模型
title.en: DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 Launches on OpenRouter at Record-Low Cost

summary.zh: DeepSeek 的 V4 Pro 0813（大型混合专家模型）已通过 OpenRouter 上线，输入每百万 token 收费 0.435 美元，输出每百万 token 收费 0.87 美元。社区基准测试显示，它能以约为 Opus 4.8 二十分之一的成本参与竞争。 此次发布表明，接近前沿水平的能力正迅速变得廉价，可能重塑开发者选择模型提供商的方式。它也凸显了 OpenRouter 这类聚合器在分发领先开源权重 AI 模型方面日益重要的作用。 该模型拥有 1,048,576 token 的上下文窗口和最高 384,000 token 的输出，并支持思考与非思考两种模式。社区测试结果不一：一位开发者报告其在复杂部署任务上出现问题，而 GPT-5.6-terra-high 能完成；另一位则表示该模型可与 Opus 4.8 竞争，但弱于 Sol 或 Fable。
summary.en: DeepSeek's V4 Pro 0813, a large mixture-of-experts model, is now available through OpenRouter at $0.435 per million input tokens and $0.87 per million output tokens. Community benchmarks show it competing with models like Opus 4.8 at roughly 20 times lower cost. This release signals that frontier-competitive capability is rapidly becoming cheap, potentially reshaping how developers choose model providers. It also underscores the growing role of aggregators like OpenRouter in distributing leading open-weight AI models. The model has a 1,048,576-token context window and a maximum output of 384,000 tokens, with support for both thinking and non-thinking modes. Community tests were mixed: one developer reported issues on a complex deployment task where GPT-5.6-terra-high succeeded, while another noted the model is competitive with Opus 4.8 but weaker than Sol or Fable.

title.zh: xAI发布Grok 4.6，引发AI基准可信度争论
title.en: xAI Launches Grok 4.6, Fueling AI Benchmark Credibility Debate

summary.zh: xAI发布了Grok 4.6，这是新的前沿AI模型。此次发布引发社区争论，用户称其在多数基准测试中超过GPT-5.6-Sol，API定价也低于Kimi K3，同时发现所有API请求都被注入了默认系统提示词。 此次发布加剧了前沿AI实验室之间的竞争，并引发了对AI能力衡量和披露方式的重要质疑。API定价变化和系统提示词策略可能影响开发者和用户。 社区成员发现xAI API会在每次请求中加入默认系统提示词，其中包含禁止提及这些规则本身的内容，这可能覆盖用户设置的系统提示词并导致拒绝回答。部分评论者也对各大实验室在两个月内快速出现'Fable级'模型表示怀疑，认为可能存在基准测试作弊或研究人员之间的知识流动。
summary.en: xAI has announced Grok 4.6, a new frontier AI model. The release has sparked community debate, with users reporting that it beats GPT-5.6-Sol on most benchmarks and undercuts Kimi K3 on API pricing, while also revealing a default system prompt injected into all API requests. This release intensifies competition among frontier AI labs and raises important questions about how AI capabilities are measured and disclosed. Developers and users could be affected by changes in API pricing and by system prompt policies that restrict model behavior. Community members found that the xAI API adds a default system prompt to every request, including a line that forbids mentioning the guidelines themselves, which can override user-supplied system prompts and cause refusals. Some commenters also voiced skepticism about the rapid appearance of 'Fable-level' models within two months across major labs, suggesting possible benchmark gaming or knowledge transfer between researchers.

summary.zh: Qwen发布了Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B，这是一个混合专家（MoE）模型，总参数2.4万亿，激活参数950亿。模型卡称其性能接近前沿水平，可与Claude Opus及Fable系列模型相媲美，并已在Hugging Face上发布BF16和FP8权重。 作为领先AI实验室发布的重要开源权重模型，Qwen3.8-2.4T通过MoE的稀疏激活大幅降低推理成本，使开源模型进一步接近闭源前沿系统。这可能加速高端开源模型在科研和生产环境中的部署。 该模型在发布时仅提供BF16和FP8精度，社区估算完整的BF16检查点约需4.9TB存储，而Unsloth的1比特量化版为397GB。开源权重版本不具备官方Qwen3.8-Max中的视觉输入和100万token上下文长度等功能。
summary.en: Qwen released Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B, a mixture-of-experts model with 2.4 trillion total parameters and 95 billion active parameters. The model card claims near-frontier performance comparable to Claude Opus and the Fable model family, with BF16 and FP8 weights published on Hugging Face. As a major open-weight release from a leading AI lab, Qwen3.8-2.4T pushes open models closer to proprietary frontier systems while keeping inference cost low through MoE's sparse activation. This could accelerate deployment of high-end open models in both research and production environments. The model is only available in BF16 and FP8 precision at launch, and community members estimate a full BF16 checkpoint needs about 4.9TB of storage, while a 1-bit quantized version from Unsloth is 397GB. The open-weight release lacks vision input and the 1M-token context length that appear in the official Qwen3.8-Max.

title.zh: 高盛以22.5亿美元收购ETF管理公司NEOS
title.en: Goldman Sachs to acquire ETF manager NEOS in $2.25B deal

summary.zh: 高盛已同意以最高22.5亿美元收购ETF管理公司NEOS Investments，将其管理的300亿美元基于期权的收益ETF业务（包括与比特币和以太币挂钩的基金）纳入高盛资产管理。该交易预计将于2027年第一季度完成，但需获得监管批准。 这笔交易标志着传统资产管理公司对加密货币挂钩投资产品的进一步接纳。高盛通过收购将向客户提供比特币和以太币收益ETF，可能扩大数字资产的机构投资者基础。 NEOS管理着19只基于期权的收益ETF，包括比特币高收益ETF（BTCI）、增强型比特币高收益ETF（XBCI）和以太币高收益ETF（NEHI），这些基金采用备兑看涨期权策略来生成月度收益。加上高盛此前收购Innovator Capital Management，该交易将使高盛的全球ETF平台资产规模达到约1300亿美元。
summary.en: Goldman Sachs has agreed to acquire ETF manager NEOS Investments for up to $2.25 billion, adding its $30 billion options-based income ETF business, including Bitcoin- and Ether-linked funds, to Goldman Sachs Asset Management. The acquisition is expected to close in the first quarter of 2027, subject to regulatory approval. This acquisition signals continued institutional adoption of crypto-linked investment products through traditional asset managers. It gives Goldman's clients access to Bitcoin and Ether income-generating ETFs, potentially broadening the institutional investor base for digital assets. NEOS manages 19 options-based income ETFs, including the Bitcoin High Income ETF (BTCI), Boosted Bitcoin High Income ETF (XBCI), and Ethereum High Income ETF (NEHI), which use covered call strategies to generate monthly income. Combined with Goldman's separate purchase of Innovator Capital Management, the deal would bring its global ETF platform to about $130 billion in assets.

title.zh: 高盛25亿美元收购NEOS，直接获得比特币收益ETF业务
title.en: Goldman's $2.25B NEOS Deal Buys Ready-Made Bitcoin Income ETF Business

summary.zh: 高盛同意以最高22.5亿美元的价格收购NEOS Investments，交易预计于2027年第一季度完成。此次收购将为高盛资产管理带来约300亿美元的期权收益ETF，其中包括规模约10亿美元的BTCI比特币备兑看涨基金。 这笔交易让高盛直接获得现成的加密收益ETF业务，绕过了其4月提交比特币溢价ETF申请的缓慢路径。这标志着大型机构入场的重大信号，因为衍生品收益ETF（资产约1800亿美元）正成为市场增长最快的领域之一，而加密资产在其中占比日益提升。 NEOS的旗舰产品BTCI通过卖出比特币持仓的备兑看涨期权来产生月度收益，以限制上涨空间换取现金流；此次收购还包括一款类似的以太坊产品。高盛4月提交的比特币溢价ETF申请使用了类似的期权写入结构，而收购NEOS是吸收成熟管理人，而非等待新基金获得市场认可。
summary.en: Goldman Sachs agreed to acquire NEOS Investments for up to $2.25 billion in a cash-and-equity deal expected to close in Q1 2027. The acquisition brings about $30 billion in options-based income ETFs under Goldman Sachs Asset Management, including the roughly $1 billion BTCI Bitcoin covered-call fund. The deal gives Goldman Sachs a ready-made crypto income ETF business, bypassing the slower path of its own April filing for a Bitcoin Premium ETF. It marks a major institutional adoption signal as derivative-income ETFs—roughly $180 billion in assets—become a fast-growing corner of the market with crypto as an increasingly prominent slice. NEOS's flagship product, BTCI, generates monthly income by selling covered calls on Bitcoin exposure, capping upside in exchange for yield; a similar Ethereum product is also included. Goldman's own April filing for a Bitcoin Premium ETF used a comparable options-writing structure, and the NEOS deal absorbs an established manager rather than waiting for a new fund to gain traction.

title.zh: 高盛以22.5亿美元收购NEOS Investments，进军比特币收益ETF
title.en: Goldman Sachs to acquire NEOS Investments in $2.25B bitcoin ETF deal

summary.zh: 高盛已同意收购NEOS Investments，该公司是管理规模11亿美元的比特币合成ETF——BTCI的管理人。这笔现金加股权的交易对NEOS的估值最高达22.5亿美元，预计在2027年初获得监管批准后完成。 此次收购是一个重要的机构采纳信号——顶级投行以22.5亿美元收购比特币收益ETF发行方。这加剧了与贝莱德在快速增长的衍生品收益ETF市场上的竞争，也凸显了比特币在传统金融领域日益被接受。 BTCI不直接持有比特币，而是通过在比特币ETP上采用备兑看涨期权（covered-call）策略来产生约27%的收益率，但过去一年已下跌约43%，费率为0.99%。这笔交易为高盛带来一个管理规模300亿美元、涵盖19只基金的期权策略ETF平台，使其ETF总资产超过1300亿美元。
summary.en: Goldman Sachs has agreed to acquire NEOS Investments, the manager of the $1.1 billion BTCI bitcoin synthetic ETF, in a cash-and-equity deal valuing NEOS at up to $2.25 billion. The transaction is expected to close in early 2027 pending regulatory approval. This acquisition marks a significant institutional adoption signal, as a top-tier bank acquires a bitcoin income ETF issuer for $2.25 billion. It intensifies competition with BlackRock in the fast-growing derivative income ETF market and underscores bitcoin's growing acceptance within traditional finance. BTCI does not directly hold bitcoin; it uses a covered-call strategy on bitcoin ETPs to generate a yield of about 27%, but has fallen roughly 43% over the past year and charges a 0.99% expense ratio. The deal gives Goldman a $30 billion options-based ETF platform across 19 funds, lifting its total ETF assets above $130 billion.
